title: Who leads a band; Arnett Nelson, Weatherford and Tommy Ladnier
summary: A tenor saxophonist leading, the band at Rich Carlton with Nelson, Weatherford, Harris, and talk of drummer Jackson and Noble Sissle.

story.theme_name: Who was in the band: naming sidemen and personnel
story.community_name: Who played in the band: reciting personnel

blocks.x: Usually the trumpet player is the leader, but sometimes the trombonists and others, if you have any ideas on who should be the leader or why in New Orleans, if they usually have to come up.

I'll tell you about the bands. Like, I've seen tenor saxophones. I saw tenor saxophone lead a band. That is the leader of the band. He took the most principled parts, see, of what he had to do, of their work. He took the principled parts of it and he led the band. See, he had trumpet players there and he gave them their parts, you know, what they had to use. But he led the band off. Then it was a nice, sweet band. That's the trumpet, trumpet, tenor saxophone. Tenor saxophone, a nice instrument anyhow. Arnett Nelson used to play with us. We played at Rich Carlton. Oh, yeah, Cotty Grove and we played there. And Arnett played the tenor saxophone. We had Weatherford. You don't know what that is. He's dead now. He's not an Indian. Died there. He played with us. Weatherford, Arnett Nelson. And a boy named Harris, drum player. A boy named Willie Harris, I think his name. He played drums with us. And Tommy Latney, you never met him. Oh, yeah.
Sure, I knew him in New York. He died too, didn't he? Yes, 1939 he died. Yeah, Tommy Latney. I heard the last records he ever made. I got to go to this session. He made it for Victor.
With Mesro and Judy Singleton. Yeah. That's how it is.
And this guy Jackson, is he playing still? A.D. Jackson?
A.D. Jackson. A.D. Jackson. I know him. I taught him.

Yeah. Yeah. Yeah. Well, not him. Just another Jackson. He played. I believe he played drum. I think he played drum. Jackson. He played. He went off from here with. He went off from here with. This guy, he has all the bands in charge. Most of Noble Sisson. He went off with Noble Sisson. And he was playing with them. He was a good drummer.
